data.name: Steppe Rider
data.detailed_description:
Steppe Rider is an educational game that combines a runner and a quiz, designed to help players learn the Kazakh language through fun and interactive gameplay.

The player embarks on a journey across the vast steppe together with a snow leopard companion, completing tasks, collecting letters and words, and unlocking new themes and levels.

Game features:

🏃 Dynamic runner with word-building challenges

🧠 Quizzes with translation and listening tasks

🏅 Three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard

🐆 Barsik the Snow Leopard — your helper and motivator

🏆 Achievements, leaderboards, and in-game currency (asyks)

🌍 Thematic modules: family, nature, animals, food, and more

Steppe Rider is suitable for children, teenagers, and adults.

Its vibrant visual style and national Kazakh motifs make learning easy and enjoyable — turning language study into an exciting adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for online features
